title: Get the AI-video-editor skill (lazy-load + auto-expand)
description:
Load the WideCast AI-VIDEO-EDITOR playbook for refining/editing an
EXISTING video. Different from /v1/skills/writing — that one is for
AUTHORING new scripts; this one is for EDITING already-generated
scenes.

**Lazy-load**: call once without `module` → get the master SKILL.md
+ an auto-discovered `available_modules[]` list. Then call again
with `module=<id>` to load a submodule.

**Auto-expand**: dropping a new `.md` under the skill folder makes
it instantly callable here — no code change, no manifest edit. The
`available_modules[]` index is rebuilt from filesystem on every
request.

**Freshness**: server caches per-module by mtime, response carries
`Cache-Control: no-store`, and the WideCast `/app/*` path bypasses
Cloudflare entirely. Always live.

fields.name: module
fields.label: module (optional — leave blank for the entry SKILL.md + index)
fields.help: Hierarchical module id without the `.md` extension, e.g. ai_video_editor/10_mechanics or ai_video_editor/styles/text_axes. Omit to load the master SKILL.md + the live available_modules list.

use_cases.title: 📚 Load the master SKILL.md + the live module index + the contract
use_cases.description: Returns SKILL.md content + an `available_modules[]` array auto-discovered from disk + an always-returned `contract` field (~1.5 KB cross-cutting rules that survive any runtime truncation). Start here so you know which submodules exist before loading any of them.

use_cases.title: ⭐ Kickoff core 1/5 — 14 critical rules + self-audit
use_cases.description: Load at run kickoff. The 14 numbered critical rules that hold across every scene (visual evidence gate, autonomous run, name-the-field, decide-by-sight, …) + the self-audit checklist run before every reply.

use_cases.title: ⛔ Kickoff core 2/5 — jump-prevention interrupts
use_cases.description: Load at run kickoff. "About to do X → STOP, do Y first" interrupt list to catch the agent before common skips.

use_cases.title: ✅ Kickoff core 3/5 — DoD gates + all template blocks
use_cases.description: Load at run kickoff (or at scene start). 9-gate per-scene Definition of Done + every template block (Gate 4 module-load / title / secondary-text proofs, Gate 5 BACKGROUND PROOF, Gate 6 screenshot checks, Gate 9 MODULE COVERAGE GATE).

use_cases.title: 📖 Kickoff core 4/5 — principles + whole-video workflow + reminders
use_cases.description: Load at run kickoff. §1 general principles, §2 whole-video workflow (initial context pass + Background Audit Ledger init), §10 long-form reminders.

use_cases.title: 🎯 Kickoff core 5/5 — quality standard + video-level QA + priority
use_cases.description: Load before declaring `Scene N: PASS` and after every scene. §7 Quality Standard, §8 video-level QA pass, §9 priority order for gate conflicts.

use_cases.title: ⚙️ Per-scene — mechanics (data + layout coords + branch table)
use_cases.description: Load at the start of every scene. Per-scene data fields, coordinate spaces, the 13 `modify_scene` branches, A-roll layout scenarios, screenshot mechanics.

use_cases.title: 🖼 Per-scene — background audit
use_cases.description: Grid-vs-real decision + footage search + Gate 5 background-pass rules. Load at Gate 5.

use_cases.title: 🅰 Per-scene — typography rules
use_cases.description: Title / label / value rules + readability gates. Load whenever the overlay has any text.

use_cases.title: 🎨 Per-scene — style recipe library
use_cases.description: Style recipes mirrored from the code (chart axes / text axes). Load alongside the matching pattern module.
